description: Remove an SSH public key, revoking its shell access — including on instances already running, which have the key withdrawn from them. Use when a key belongs to a laptop that is gone, a person who has left, or one the user does not recognise from list_ssh_keys. Call it with confirm:false first for a preview of which key would go. Recoverable only by the person holding the private half: re-registering the same public key restores access, and nobody else can do it for them. Free, and it changes nothing about billing — instances keep running and accruing their hourly cost; only the way in is closed. Anyone connected through that key is disconnected.

confirm.description: false returns a preview of the key that would be removed

name: delete_ssh_key
